correctness.rationale: Headline claim |G(3,4,5;2)|=360 independently re-verified from committed integers. Auditor re-ran inputs/artifacts/tc.py Enumeration on relators [a^3,b^4,(ab)^5,[a,b]^2]: status DONE, 402 defs, 618 passes, 42 coincidences, 360 live cosets, compact pa/pb byte-identical to cert_G345k2.json; independent checker (perms + relator closure + transitivity) passes. Auditor separately checked V1 permutations, V2 all 4 relators close at all 360 points (1440 traces), V3 transitivity from 0, V4 perm orders |a|=3,|b|=4,|ab|=5 (corrected composition order pb(pa(.))), |[a,b]|=2. Closed transitive relator-satisfying action gives standard TC upper bound |G|<=360 plus transitive-image lower bound N||image|<=|G|, hence |G|=360: proof, not mere experiment. BFS closure of <pa,pb> in S_360 has exactly 360 elements (regular), element orders {1:1,2:45,3:80,4:90,5:144}, center order 1, conjugacy-class sizes [1,40,40,45,72,72,90] summing to 360, all matching DRAFT/structure file. Abelianization: relations 3a=0,4b=0,5a+5b=0 have 2x2 minors 12,15,-20 with gcd 1, so trivial abelianization (perfect) as claimed. Baseline T(3,4,5) infiniteness via 1/3+1/4+1/5=47/60<1 hyperbolic Fuchsian trichotomy is correctly cited as classical background, not re-proved, which is acceptable; committed perms satisfy the three baseline relators so G is a quotient image of T, and finite-vs-infinite gives proper quotient. All five sibling certs also pass V1-V3 relator closure + transitivity (orders 12,3,144,240,504). Non-load-bearing weakness: rs_index_check_G345k2.json is a summary flag (index 120, holds:true) with no committed coset table, so the RS cross-check 360=120x3 is asserted, not independently replayable; headline order does not depend on it. verify_G345k2.py hardcodes a research-workspace absolute path so the literal DRAFT replay command needs path adjustment, but the checks themselves pass when pointed at committed files.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison finds no prior stating or mechanically implying |G(3,4,5;2)|=360 with a coset-table witness. Nearest results are orthogonal in object/method/claim: Caprace-Conder-Kaluba-Witzel arXiv:2011.09276 studies k-fold generalized triangle groups (CAT(0) triangle-complex, edge-stabilizers cyclic of order k) for infiniteness/property (T)/large-rank simple quotients, not ordinary-triangle-plus-[a,b]^k finiteness orders; arXiv all-field search 'triangle group commutator' returns only Parker-Will arXiv:1510.01505 (complex-hyperbolic Riley slice, (3,3,infinity) discreteness) and Isola-Piergallini arXiv:1405.1881 (generic Euclidean triangle, free-metabelian), neither closing this window; classical (l,m,n) spherical/Euclidean/hyperbolic trichotomy does not imply any extra-relator collapse order; deformation-theoretic simple-quotient existence, profinite rigidity, and BS-triangle collapse families address different presentations/methods. Auditor's live fetches confirm Caprace abstract/scope and the two commutator search hits. Hence the specific terminating table is narrowly new as a computational fact. Priority is not established by timestamp alone; it is established here by absence of the concrete order-plus-table in the checked priors. PASS is narrow (new number + table) and does not extend to conceptual novelty, which is assessed under value.

value.rationale: Even taking correctness and narrow novelty as given, the contribution is an unexplained single-window enumeration, not an independently retrievable advance. The window (hyperbolic triples with entries <=6 crossed with k<=5; headline one of 76 presentations, 70 reported inconclusive at a 1500-coset cap with no infiniteness witnesses) is an arbitrary bounded box atop the closed textbook (l,m,n) trichotomy, and the method is routine bounded Todd-Coxeter reporting which cases terminate. No general finiteness criterion, no finite-vs-infinite boundary characterization, no extremal/structural theorem, and explicitly no isomorphism identification (the order-360 datum is left as a bare number; the class/order table in fact matches A6 but this is disclaimed as observation only). Sibling orders include the near-trivial C3 collapse and four more bare numbers with the same deficit. Downstream uses (residual finiteness, growth gaps, benchmarks, hypermap/Hurwitz/property-(T) quotients) are asserted, not demonstrated by any downstream theorem, example, or adopted benchmark. The fallback census also fails its own bar: 70/76 inconclusive is not a complete finite-vs-infinite census with extremal table. Under SCOPE value policy this is textbook-trichotomy-plus-parameter-substitution / unexplained enumeration / tiny unmotivated gain: correct and narrowly new but not worth finding later as mathematics.
